description: This file defines an abstract class SugarWebService that serves as a base for all web services in the SuiteCRM project. It includes method declarations for registration, class management, serving requests, and error handling, along with class properties.

classes.name: SugarWebService
classes.description: An abstract base class for web services in the SuiteCRM platform, outlining essential methods to manage registration, class handling, and error reporting.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the web service, optionally excluding certain functions.

methods.name: registerImplClass
methods.description: Registers an implementation class for the web service.

methods.name: getRegisteredImplClass
methods.description: Retrieves the currently registered implementation class.

methods.name: registerClass
methods.description: Registers a class related to the web service.

methods.name: getRegisteredClass
methods.description: Retrieves a class registered for the web service.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Handles serving the web service request.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles errors by accepting an error object.
